services.name: Hell’s Gate Jet Boat Tours
services.desc: Incredible opportunities for outdoor adventures such as whitewater jet boating, fishing for white sturgeon, salmon and fly fishing remote rivers. STS Guiding Service has been offering the above services for the past 19 years and is now offering Whitewater Jet Boating and Scenic Jet boat tours on the Fraser River, as well as Vancouver and surrounding area. Join us for Thrilling, Exciting, Scenic, Whitewater Jet Boating in British Columbia’s Fraser Canyon. Daily departures are available from Hope and Harrison Hot Springs, year round. We also offer scenic tours of the Lillooet River, Pitt River and Harrison Hot Springs area. Our River Jet Boats are custom designed with your comfort in mind ,

services.name: Fraser River Raft Expeditions
services.desc: The Fraser River is as unique and different as the people that have traveled it, from thousands of years ago to today. The reasons for and methods of travel may have changed but mostly the river stays the same. At Fraser River Raft Expeditions we are proud to offer a variety of choices in expeditions down the Fraser and its tributaries. The river trips we offer vary from large volume rivers like the Mighty Fraser and Thompson to small volume such as the Nahatlatch and Coquihalla. Our rafts range from large powered rafts to the much smaller paddle rafts. We are conveniently located just 2 hours North of Vancouver BC in the tiny town of Yale.
